project.name: TOPROP Website
project.purpose: Lead-generating website for property management, rentals and investment services for private and commercial property owners.
project.brand_positioning: Property management company with investor mindset: manage the property, improve income, reduce risk, and give owners transparent control.
project.tagline_he: מנהלים את הנכס. ממקסמים את ההשקעה.

rules: First inspect the existing project before deleting or replacing anything.
Keep existing code/assets only if they are useful, maintainable, accessible, responsive, SEO-friendly, and consistent with the new TOPROP positioning.
Delete obsolete, duplicated, broken, off-brand, placeholder or unused pages/components/assets.
If the existing architecture is fundamentally weak, create a clean v2 structure and migrate only validated assets/content.
Never change the TOPROP logo artwork unless explicitly requested.
Treat PROJECT.md as the living source of truth and update it after every meaningful implementation phase.
Read and use any local Claude/VS Code skills that exist in the repository before implementing UI or architecture.
Do not invent business claims, customer counts, years of experience, managed asset value, reviews or case-study numbers.
Use real content only; use clearly labeled demo/placeholder data in mockups.

phase_0_audit.goal: Understand the current codebase and decide what to keep, refactor, remove or rebuild.

decision_matrix.keep: Good quality, reusable, aligned with new site.
decision_matrix.rebuild: Core architecture or page is too weak to safely evolve.

preferred.backend: Supabase when backend features are required
preferred.auth: Supabase Auth for admin/owner portal when introduced
preferred.storage: Supabase Storage for future documents/media where appropriate
preferred.forms: Server Actions or API route with validation
preferred.email: Provider abstraction; do not hard-code vendor-specific logic
preferred.whatsapp: CTA links initially; API integration later

design_system.source: Use the uploaded TOPROP logo and derive the visual language from it.
design_system.style: Premium corporate real estate + modern fintech dashboard feel.
rules: White should dominate large content areas.
Use navy for authority and structure.
Use gold for CTAs, highlights and premium details.
Avoid excessive metallic effects or visual noise.
Use real estate imagery sparingly and intentionally.
Dashboards and data visualizations may be used to reinforce transparency and control.

after_submit: Do not promise automatic valuation unless a real valuation engine exists.

principles: Show starting prices or ranges only where approved.
Clearly state minimum monthly fee and that complexity/property type can affect pricing.
Separate management fees from brokerage, project management, cleaning, repairs and external vendor costs.
Do not publish guaranteed-rent promises as a standard product.

technical: Unique title and meta description per page
content_rules: Write for owners, not for search engines.
Publish local pages only when unique local content exists.

requirements: Track conversion source to lead record.
Do not load marketing trackers before consent if legally required.
MFA for admin when admin auth exists.
Supabase RLS when database/auth is introduced.
Do not expose owner/tenant data publicly.

include: Basic content settings if easy to maintain

required_files.PROJECT.md: Living project definition, current architecture, scope, decisions, routes, data model, env vars and current status.
required_files.KEEP_REMOVE_REFACTOR.md: Explicit list of what remains, changes, or is deleted.
required_files.DECISIONS.md: Architecture and product decisions with rationale.

definition_of_done: Existing project was audited before rebuild decisions.
Homepage communicates TOPROP value in under 5 seconds.
All forms validate and persist leads reliably.
Hebrew RTL is correct on desktop and mobile.
Accessibility and performance targets are checked.
PROJECT.md and other documentation reflect the actual codebase.
npm run build passes with no blocking errors.

claude_code_execution_prompt.instruction: Act as senior product engineer, UX architect and conversion-focused web developer. Start by auditing the current repository. Do not delete or rebuild blindly. Read all repository instructions and installed skills first. Produce AUDIT.md and KEEP_REMOVE_REFACTOR.md, then update PROJECT.md. Only after the audit, implement the TOPROP website in ordered phases using this JSON as the product source of truth. Keep each phase buildable, testable and documented. Before finishing each phase, run type checks/build/tests available in the project and update PROJECT.md, TASKS.md and CHANGELOG.md.
